answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 146086 Country: India Title: About all bath soaps and skin creams contain isopropyl alcohol . Is it haram or halal? Question: About all bath soaps and skin creams contain isopropyl alcohol . Is it haram or halal? Answer ID: 146086 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 140/107/D=2/1438) It is allowable to use the soap and skin cream though they contain isopropyl alcohol. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
